content:
claire: Quick note 1 - Helios Systems just uploaded a compliance bundle for marketplace listing (firmware images, manifest.json, SOC2 excerpt, vendor questionnaire). Legal/security want a tight publish vs reviewer split + a small reproducible playbook.
ryan-sec: Key sensitive fields: serial, hw_id, mac, internal_hostname, private_key; no PEMs in public artifacts.
vega-partner: We can provide signer_cert only to NDA reviewers. For public bundle we prefer placeholders.
pat-legal: Legal needs: (A) redacted manifest for public listing; (B) SOC2 controls summary redacted of auditor PII; (C) a one-line attestation from Helios. Full firmware and full pen-report must be available only to authorized reviewers under NDA + evidence access addendum.
nina-ops: Ops checklist proposal: 1) deterministic redaction of manifest (REDACTED-<8hex>) 2) compute SHA256 of raw + redacted artifacts 3) upload public bundle to marketplace-assets/helios/ 4) store raw evidence in KMS CMK bucket with 12mo retention + MFA delete 5) create presigned link for NDA reviewers after access ticket approval (TTL=7d).
audit-bot: audit-bot: always record: requester, approver, purpose, object SHA256s, presign TTL, and IAM role used.
ryan-sec: Small jq example partners can run to redact manifest fields:```bash
jq '.serial = "REDACTED" | .hw_id = "REDACTED" | .mac = "REDACTED" | del(.signer_cert)' manifest.json > manifest.public.json
```
vega-partner: For deterministic placeholders we will send actual IDs to ops over secure channel so you can map to REDACTED-<8hex>. Good to avoid losing referential integrity.
pat-legal: Draft listing copy suggestion: "Sensitive device identifiers and internal configuration details have been removed from the public package. Full artifacts are available to authorized reviewers under NDA." I'll finalize wording and attach the evidence addendum.
claire: Timeline: Nina to run redaction + publish public bundle by EOD tomorrow; Vega to provide attestation and reviewer contact; Ryan to validate SOC2 excerpt redactions; Pat to post final listing copy. Post presign link + SHA256 here when ready.
nina-ops: On it. I'll post presign + audit entry in this thread once the upload is done.
claire: Thanks team 1 - marking this thread canonical for Helios marketplace artifact handling. If anything changes ping @claire.
